title: Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease Wear Forgiveness Basis: Advance Inspection and Excess Item Count
content:
**Inspection desk guidance — how much of the excess wear charge forgiveness is measured on, Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease**

**Rule.** The wear forgiveness basis depends on the lease's complimentary advance inspection and on the number of excess items on the final turn-in inspection report:

1. **Per item** — when the lease's complimentary advance inspection was performed and the final turn-in inspection report records more than 5 excess items: each excess item is forgiven up to the per-item limit of $100, and the items' forgiven amounts together never exceed the excess wear charge or the total limit.
2. **Share of the charge** — when no complimentary advance inspection was performed: 50 percent of the excess wear charge is forgiven, never more than the total limit.
3. **Aggregate** — in every other case: the excess wear charge is forgiven up to the total limit.

The *total limit* is the wear forgiveness cap of the turn-in together with every amount added to that cap.

**Counting the excess items.** The excess items counted are those recorded as assessed with severity excess on the final turn-in inspection report, an item removed on an inspection dispute not counted. Where two final turn-in reports share the latest inspection date, the first one recorded is read, and a lease with no final turn-in report counts no item.

**Combinations**

| Complimentary advance inspection performed | Excess items counted | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| yes | 6 or more | per item, $100 each |
| yes | 5 or fewer | aggregate |
| no | any number | 50 percent of the charge |

**Worked figures (all inputs hypothetical; total limit $750)**

- Advance inspection performed; the final report records 7 excess items, one of them removed on dispute, so 6 are counted; excess wear charge $1190. Per item: 6 items at up to $100 each, $600, which is under both the charge and the $750 limit — $600 is forgiven.
- Advance inspection performed; 5 excess items; charge $1040. Aggregate: the charge is forgiven up to the limit — $750.
- No advance inspection; charge $1040. Share: 50 percent is $520, under the limit — $520 is forgiven.
- No advance inspection; charge $1900. Share: 50 percent is $950, held to the limit — $750.
